chapters.title: Fed Holds With Two Hawkish Dissents
Lagarde Exits as Central Banks Hike
What Oil Teaches Us About AI

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: I think gold is probably getting hit here as you know the energy short nations are trying to defend currency. The dollar's been been super strong.
moments.reason: energy-short countries sell gold to defend their currencies while the dollar is strong

moments.speaker: Felix Jauvin
moments.quote: people are just trying to sell what they can and it sounds like to your point that's also what sovereigns are doing to, you know, defend their currencies amidst this energy shock.
moments.reason: gold below 3,900 as funds and central banks sell what they can

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: there's a liquidity crunch. So, you're going to you're going to you're getting tapped on the shoulder whether you're the PM at a pod or a a treasury manager at at a central bank.
moments.reason: a liquidity crunch forces holders to sell gold to cover other losses

moments.speaker: Felix Jauvin
moments.quote: Yeah, I think that summarizes what we talked about last week, which is that like fundamentally gold is is good here
moments.reason: the long-run case for gold is intact

moments.speaker: Felix Jauvin
moments.quote: but you need to wait out this this bleed in the interim. Um or yeah, you just you have to come in with a trading plan
moments.reason: wait out the selling first, or trade it with a plan

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: hey, below those summer lows, I' not going to really care. If we if we recover and regain some moving averages
moments.reason: stands aside below the summer lows; interested again only if gold reclaims them and the moving averages

moments.speaker: both
moments.quote: But yeah, like you said, yeah, step aside. Yeah, step aside. Wait it out.
moments.reason: both: step aside on gold for now

moments.speaker: Felix Jauvin
moments.quote: the capex guidance is below the estimate to me that that's that's the you know show's over
moments.reason: hyperscaler capex guidance missed estimates twice this week (MSFT 38B vs 45B, GOOGL 51B vs 55B)

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: So I just think that like from from my investment perspective like this stuff is interesting on pops and to short
moments.reason: leveraged bubble unwinding; sells rallies, expects a long bleed like past bubbles

moments.speaker: Felix Jauvin
moments.quote: I guess just equity issuance is kind of your main leg right now and that's just why would you want to own that?
moments.reason: credit window shut for neoclouds; equity issuance dilutes holders

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: And we're seeing it with open models. But it's very very very bearish from a investment perspective
moments.reason: compute becoming a commodity means margins go to zero

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: I don't think we're at the buying point yet, but we will be at some point.
moments.reason: not yet time to buy the AI/semis selloff

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: And then maybe I'll say my first bullish thing about semi semiconductors [laughter] in 2027.
moments.reason: possible turn to bullish on semis in 2027

moments.speaker: Felix Jauvin
moments.quote: what's concerning now is that we're back at those those similar lows of that leverage wash out but now it's about the fundamental story.
moments.reason: back at the July lows, but now capex misses make it fundamental, not just leverage

moments.speaker: Felix Jauvin
moments.quote: So, I'm I'm reevaluating a little bit that that that fundamental bullishness.
moments.reason: the $6.36B Binance hack hurts sentiment; less constructive on crypto

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: for me, nothing's changed cuz I'm I'm not long anything. And this is a also what happens in bare markets.
moments.reason: not long anything; treats the hack as bear-market behaviour

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: my base case is that we don't it's not really fertile conditions until sometime next year.
moments.reason: conditions not right for crypto until sometime next year; stay patient

moments.speaker: Felix Jauvin
moments.quote: But uh yeah, it is more of a bottomy signal than a top one, that's for sure.
moments.reason: time capitulation; the hack looks more like a bottom signal

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: gold's now completely retraced and set new lows. could be ominous sign uh for for Bitcoin as well
moments.reason: gold and BTC rallied for the same reasons; gold's new lows may lead BTC lower

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: there's a record energy crisis in oil supply and prices might, you know, go to 150 soon
moments.reason: record supply crisis; sees oil possibly going to 150 soon

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: If you look out at any of the experies in early 27, which is what we've been advocating for longing
moments.reason: long oil futures expiring early 2027; up and to the right even during peace

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: the supply disruption is so great that the US has to has to unblock it like this it will just be a one-way train higher if they don't rectify it.
moments.reason: supply disruption forces US action; otherwise a one-way move higher

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: And there's no positioning. Price rises every day in this asset. And futures positioning is falling.
moments.reason: price rising while positioning falls; nobody is long

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: but the dollar should probably start peeking out when when the market catches on to, you know, the emptiness of the Fed's promises
moments.reason: the market will see through the Fed's hawkish talk; dollar likely peaks

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: I think that will end up, you know, kind of dampening this dollar a cent and eventually getting it to roll over, but it could, like I said, take months.
moments.reason: AI unwind + oil hit demand, Fed forced to ease, dollar rolls over (could take months)

moments.speaker: Quinn Thompson
moments.quote: go to 150 soon and then growth in stocks are going to get smoked
moments.reason: an oil spike plus the AI unwind hits growth stocks; the Fed cannot help
